title: Best Men's Boxers and Underwear UK
short: Nine pairs of men's moisture-wicking boxers tested for support, chafing and sweat-wicking during real workouts, from a £24.99 breathable pair to a £32 compression-style short.
intro: The wrong underwear can ruin a workout, or a long day, through chafing, poor support or fabric that traps sweat instead of moving it away. This guide is based on Men's Fitness UK's tested roundup (updated 15 September 2026), where reviewers Kieran Alger and Laurence McJannet wore each pair for real workouts and everyday use, assessing sweat-wicking and drying speed, waistband and thigh-cuff comfort, material quality, support, stretch, chafing risk on long or sweaty sessions, and available sizing.

products.name: Endurance Shorts
products.best_for: Buyers who train hard and want maximum support and durability
products.key_spec: 70% nylon, 30% elastane, near-seamless design, bonded anti-chafe seams
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK's top pick, scoring full marks for support, comfort and durability. More baselayer-style compression short than everyday boxer, with bonded seams eliminating chafe risk and a multi-panel waistband spreading pressure evenly. Testers found them the lightest on test, with first-class moisture management even over long endurance sessions.

products.name: Kinetic Shorts
products.best_for: Buyers who want the most secure support for dynamic, high-movement workouts
products.key_spec: 85% nylon, 15% elastane, trademark BallPark pouch, available in 5-inch and 8-inch leg lengths
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK found Saxx's trademark BallPark pouch keeps everything securely in place no matter how much movement is involved, with no rubbing or chafing even during all-out cardio, helped by numerous flatlock seams. The longer 8-inch version has a baselayer-like feel, while a shorter 5-inch option suits those who prefer a boxer-brief style.
pros: Unique BallPark pouch keeps everything secure
No chafing even during intense cardio
cons: Can struggle to move sweat as well as top-rated pairs

products.name: Boxer Brief
products.best_for: Buyers who want maximum comfort without sacrificing support
products.key_spec: Bamboo viscose, silky polyamide gusset panel, elasticated 3D comfort pouch
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK found this Aussie brand's bamboo viscose delivers genuinely chafe-free comfort and support whatever the workout. Testers particularly liked the silky smooth gusset panel for breathability and the elasticated pouch design, and the brand backs it with a money-back guarantee on your first worn pair.

products.name: Always In Motion Boxers
products.best_for: Buyers who overheat easily and want the lightest, most breathable option
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK found this wood-based Modal fabric produces some of the lightest, comfiest moisture-wicking underwear on test, with minimal seams and great moisture management ideal for hot, sweaty sessions. Testers noted they're versatile enough for all-day everyday wear too, not just workouts.
pros: Great moisture management for hot workouts
cons: Not the most supportive option on test

products.name: Pro 7
products.best_for: Buyers who overheat and want maximum airflow during long sessions

products.summary: Men's Fitness UK rated breathability on these as second to none, thanks to strategically placed mesh panels and silky smooth fabric. Testers wore them for both day-long outdoor adventures and short HIIT sessions, finding the 7-inch legs stayed put through dynamic movement, though support falls slightly short of the very best on test.

On the pricey side per pair (cheaper in three-packs)

products.name: Merino Boxer Brief
products.best_for: Buyers who need underwear to stay fresh over multiple wears without washing
products.key_spec: 88% merino wool, 12% nylon, reinforced supportive pouch
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK recommends natural merino fibres for genuinely nipping odour in the bud, and found this pair regulates temperature and resists smells effectively while feeling luxuriously soft. Nylon reinforcement adds shape and stretch, though it lacks the lock-tight support of dedicated compression-style options.

guide.q: Compression short, boxer brief, or regular boxer?
guide.a: Men's Fitness UK found a compression-style short like the CXP Endurance Shorts gives the most support and is best suited to serious training, while a boxer brief like the Saxx Kinetic or Step One balances support with everyday comfort. Choose based on how intense your typical use is: gym and sport favours more compression, everyday wear favours a looser boxer brief.

guide.q: What fabric should I look for?
guide.a: Synthetic blends like nylon-elastane (CXP, Saxx) generally wick moisture fastest and dry quickest for intense workouts. Natural fibres like merino wool (Smartwool) or bamboo viscose (Step One) are prized for odour control and softness, while Modal (Lululemon) is exceptionally light and breathable for hot conditions.

guide.q: How does Men's Fitness UK actually test underwear?
guide.a: Reviewers wear each pair for real workouts and everyday situations, judging sweat-wicking speed, waistband and thigh-cuff comfort, material quality, support, stretch, and chafing risk over long or sweaty sessions, rather than just assessing them on a shop rail.

guide.q: Do I need dedicated sports underwear, or will everyday boxers do?
guide.a: For light daily wear, a comfortable, breathable pair like the Lululemon Always In Motion works fine for both gym and general use. If you train intensely or run regularly, dedicated support and anti-chafe features like those on the CXP or Saxx make a genuine difference over long or sweaty sessions.
